description: This file defines a React component 'NoteViewFileDropTarget' that provides a drag-and-drop target for uploading files and linking them to a specific note within a notes application interface. It manages drag events, communicates with controllers to handle file linking, and updates application state accordingly.

classes.name: Props
classes.description: TypeScript type defining the properties (note, controllers, and DOM element) expected by the component.

methods.name: NoteViewFileDropTarget
methods.description: React functional component implementing file drag-and-drop area for linking files to a note.
